# NEON DISTRICT (05 · arcade)

A synthwave arcade bar: CRT scanlines, perspective grid floor, and box-shadow pixel sprites.

- **Technique:** CANVAS + CRT
- **Tags:** retro, synthwave, neon, 80s, gaming, nightlife, playful, pixel
- **Best for:** bars & nightlife; gaming; events; entertainment
- **Fonts:** Press Start 2P, Orbitron, Chakra Petch
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Orbitron:wght@400;600;800&family=Chakra+Petch:wght@300;400;600&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0d0518 · #ff3ec8 · #38e8ff
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/arcade/` (Template.astro, coin.ts, content.ts, meta.ts, perspectiveGrid.ts, sprites.ts, starfield.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `coin.ts`
  - `initCoin(button: HTMLElement, counter: HTMLElement)` — "Insert coin" easter egg: each click bumps the credits counter. At 7 coins a warning is appended; at 10 the counter shows the unlocked message and the count resets. Reads `data-prefix`, `data-warning` and `data-unlocked` from the counter.
- `perspectiveGrid.ts`
  - `initPerspectiveGrid(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Synthwave floor: pink→cyan rays converging on the horizon and 14 pink lines sliding toward the viewer. Holds a single still frame under reduced motion.
- `sprites.ts`
  - `spriteShadow(id: SpriteId)` — CSS `box-shadow` value that paints a sprite from one 8px element: one shadow per lit pixel, filled with the cabinet's `--c` custom property so it follows the theme.
- `starfield.ts`
  - `initStarfield(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Twinkling stars across the upper 62% of the hero. Draws a single still frame under reduced motion.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<a>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Pixel-art sprite drawn on a cabinet. */
export type SpriteId = 'invader' | 'ship' | 'ghost' | 'sword';

/** Palette token a cabinet glows with (`--pink`, `--cyan`, `--yellow`, `--purple`). */
export type Accent = 'pink' | 'cyan' | 'yellow' | 'purple';

export interface Cabinet {
  sprite: SpriteId;
  accent: Accent;
  /** Game title; use <br> to break lines. */
  titleHtml: string;
  genre: string;
  /** High-score line, e.g. "HI 894,210". */
  hi: string;
  /** Small line under the high score. */
  note: string;
}

export interface GameEvent {
  /** Weekday, shown above the time. */
  day: string;
  time: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  fee: string;
}

export interface MenuItem {
  name: string;
  sub: string;
  price: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Brand logo in the nav and footer; <b> glows pink, <i> glows cyan. */
  logoHtml: string;
  /** Section anchors available: #games, #events, #menu. Nav links are hidden below 900px. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** The coin button in the nav and the credits counter it drives. */
  coin: {
    label: string;
    /** Counter prefix, e.g. "CREDITS". */
    credits: string;
    /** Appended at the 7th coin. */
    warning: string;
    /** Replaces the count at the 10th coin. */
    unlocked: string;
  };
  hero: {
    /** Blinking tag on the sign's top edge. */
    open: string;
    /** Sign text: wrap the first word in `<span class="n">` (pink) and the second in `<span class="d">` (cyan). */
    headingHtml: string;
    taglineHtml: string;
  };
  games: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; cabinets: Cabinet[] };
  events: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; items: GameEvent[] };
  menu: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    columns: { title: string; items: MenuItem[] }[];
  };
  footer: { addressHtml: string; gameOver: string; creditHtml: string };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered only when the Template receives `showcase`. */
  showcase?: { chipLabel: string; chipHref: string; footerHtml: string };
}
```
